hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Track the length of the current strictly increasing contiguous segment and strictly decreasing contiguous segment simultaneously.

hints.title: Streak Updates
hints.text: Compare each element with its immediate predecessor. If greater, extend increasing streak and reset decreasing. If smaller, extend decreasing and reset increasing.

hints.title: Equal Elements
hints.text: When adjacent elements are equal, reset both increasing and decreasing streak counters to one.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking two integer counters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested subarray validation takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintain both directional streaks simultaneously in linear time.
